_comment: Capability -> backend routing. Agents ask for a CAPABILITY ('vision', 'reasoning'), never a vendor or model name, so the brain behind a capability can be swapped without touching agent code. Local providers are listed first deliberately: the system must work on this machine with no external API and no network, and a cloud provider is an optional upgrade, never a dependency. When the purpose-trained local model for this system exists, adopting it is an edit to this file.

_provider_notes.ollama: Local. Text goes through the ollama CLI; vision goes through the HTTP API at /api/generate, which is the only path that accepts images.
_provider_notes.anthropic: Optional cloud. Skipped automatically unless its `requires` env var is set, so a missing key degrades capability rather than breaking the call.
_provider_notes.mycos_core: MYCOS Core, the purpose-trained local model. Adopted by adding "mycos_core" to a capability's provider list - the single config flip. It reads a PROMOTED artifact from mycelial-core/models/promoted/, which that repo exports only when its gate returns PROMOTE. The OS PULLS; mycelial-core never writes here, and its tools/check_boundary.py fails that repo's build if any code path tries. STATUS 2026-09-11: no promoted artifact exists. The first smoke run trained a 7M checkpoint on 6 pairs and the gate correctly returned HOLD, so there is nothing to point at yet. This entry is the socket, not a claim that something is plugged into it.

synthesis._note: Reasoning across a whole domain snapshot (several data sources at once) rather than classifying one short string. Ordered largest-local-first: the 1.5b used for single-string classification loses the thread on a multi-section prompt.

chain.note: ~1.7GB, runs CPU-only in the RAM this host has free.

_mycos_core.why_unavailable: No checkpoint has passed the gate.
_mycos_core.adopt_by: add "mycos_core" to the providers list of a capability below
